newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Monday it raised its overnight borrowing rate to 11.50 percent from 11.0 percent but left its overnight lending rate unchanged at 12.65 percent.
Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza told Reuters the rise was intended to quell peso speculation.
Banks have been jittery for a week now over possible large outflows following heavy selling in the stock market.
This is the second time in less than a week that the Central Bank has raised overnight rates, bringing the total increase to 1.25 percentage points.
Traders said the Central Bank unloaded over $100 million on Wednesday and up to $19 million on Friday to calm the market.
